# Meta-Stamp Pockets

> Licensing and receipts for AI agent access to creator content. When an agent comes to Meta-Stamp for a piece of content, the visit goes on the record: a licensed pull returns the content with a receipt, a refused one returns a receipt that says no, and the owner's ledger gets the same entry. One visit, two receipts, one independent record.

## Access

- [MCP endpoint](https://metastampv3-production.up.railway.app/mcp): Model Context Protocol server. Tools: search_pockets, list_pockets, pull_content. API key required.
- [Get an API key](https://app.meta-stamp.com/customer-signup): sign-up for agents and developers

## How it works

- The owner sets the price, per asset.
- A paid pull licenses use in generation, retrieval and inference. Training is not included; it takes a separate license.
- Every visit, paid or refused, leaves a receipt for the agent and an entry in the owner's ledger.

## Contact

- [Email](mailto:chris@meta-stamp.com): catalog owners, creators and licensing
